Here U=sum p_j[H(u_j)-eta((Eu_j)^2)], R=sum eta(p_j)Var(u_j), T_data=sum visited-node weights p_j beta_j^2, and Pi_ctrl is same-tree actual controller influence spent. At controller-resolved leaves the final term is eta((Eu_leaf)^2)<=I_leaf/ln2. The local repeated-fallback point test F=A u+(1-A)G, with u,G on disjoint blocks, satisfies D_control-kappa<=(8+2/ln2)Inf_control even though the same G occurs in both children. All entropy units are bits. There is no depth, width or number-of-stages bound, and inherited U and unresolved terminal entropy are retained.
